title: The forum story should convert investors through **4** steps from Angola awareness to sector conviction, opportunity screening, and post-forum engagement
subtitle: Illustrative investor journey that uses the forum as a conversion path rather than a one-off pitch, moving from country proof points to actionable next steps

phases.title: Angola credibility comes first because investors need a country case before they assess any specific opportunity
phases.body: Open with the investment narrative that makes Angola legible to Indian capital, establishing why the market deserves attention before asking investors to evaluate sectors or assets.

phases.title: Sector focus sharpens interest by narrowing the story from broad market potential to investable themes
phases.body: Move from the country case to a small set of priority sectors so investor attention concentrates on areas where Angola can present a differentiated fit for Indian participants.

phases.title: Opportunity screening turns sector interest into real demand by attaching concrete deals to each priority theme
phases.body: Present investor-ready opportunities inside the selected sectors so forum conversations shift from thematic curiosity to active evaluation of specific entry points.

phases.title: Structured follow-up converts forum momentum into a pipeline by defining the engagement path immediately after the event
phases.body: Close with a clear post-forum process for outreach, qualification, and progression so interest captured at the forum advances into a managed investment pipeline.
